notes:
Key contact: Elena Ramos (Head of Product) and Steven Cho (VP Eng).

Quick summary: started on Hosted API to validate models -> positive QA on embeddings and chat -> now shifting to Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Primary drivers: consistent 95p latency (<150ms), predictable unit cost, and VPC + KMS for keys.

Product/technical requirements - notes from SE meetings:
- Workloads: conversational in-product assistant (multi-turn), vector search over 50M docs, reranking for recommendation flows.
- Target: 50 QPS sustained, spike bursts to 500 QPS for launch windows. 95p latency target ~120-150ms for chat.
- Model prefs: prefer LLaMA-family quantized variants or curated open models; fallback path to smaller model for cost SLOs.
- Ops: need prefix/KV caching, per-route routing (low-latency vs cost-optimal), canaries for rollouts.
- Security: SSO/SAML + SCIM needed, enterprise KMS (customer-managed), audit logs retained 7 years for certain events, data residency US-only for first phase.

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Initial ask: committed pool equivalent to 8 A100-class GPUs with ability to burst up to +50% for 72 hours/month.
- Aurora pushed back on overage linear pricing; proposing tiered capping (soft overage up to 20%, hard cap afterwards).
- They want a 12-month ramp schedule: month1 40% commit, month4 70%, month7 100% (full commit).
- Finance asked for blended per-token estimate and a separate line item for reserved burst hours.

Legal / procurement status:
- Legal submitted DPA redlines 2025-03-01; waiting on Redwood legal to confirm changes.
- SOC2 report target: Redwood to provide most recent; Aurora compliance needs verified by 2025-03-20 to progress.

Quotes from calls:
- Elena: "We need predictable bills — last-minute overages are a blocker for C-suite signoff."
- Steven: "If latency is stable at scale, we can accelerate launch by 6 weeks."

Open action items (short):
- SE to deliver dedicated perf runbook with expected tail latency at proposed commit sizes (owner: Maya, due 2025-03-07).
- Commercial to provide 2 pricing options: (A) conservative commit + lower overage; (B) aggressive ramp + cheaper baseline rate.
- Legal: Redwood to respond to DPA redlines (owner: legal@redwood).
- Schedule exec pricing call 2025-03-10 (Jordan + Elena + finance).

Stitch notes: friction around overage cadence and SOC2 timing — likely procurement lever is flexible burst pool + ramped commit. Keep options to trade commitment length vs per-unit price.
